title: Cuando la tierra era niña
author: Nathaniel Hawthorne (trad. G. Martínez Sierra)
note: Cuando la tierra era niña (Hawthorne's A Wonder-Book, translated by G. Martínez Sierra, 1920): six Greek myths retold for children, each introduced by a scene of its frame story (a student telling them to children at Tanglewood). Each item starts at that frame scene's heading (EL PÓRTICO DE TANGLEWOOD...) and runs through its myth; lines in capitals (each myth's half-title and title, the closing frame headings) are dropped. Ends at FIN.
chapters: EN EL CUARTO DE JUEGO DE TANGLEWOOD
EN LA VERTIENTE DE LA COLINA
